dedupe_keys.name: western canada monthly hydropower generation and flexibility

description: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory publishes simulated monthly hydropower generation and flexibility for western Canada. The Zenodo release describes 110 modelled facilities in British Columbia and Alberta from 1981 through 2019, with a broader metadata list of 146 facilities. CSV outputs include generation in megawatt-hours and flexibility in megawatts. Scaling fields refer to 2008 generation and water-licence intake constraints. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. These series can inform generation and operational-flexibility assumptions in Canadian power-system simulations; data-godeeep-hydro-power-system-ready-hydropower provides a related United States resource. A caveat is that modelled values are not observed dispatch records. The provider warns that extreme floods, unprecedented droughts and changing water policies are outside the represented conditions. Facility identifiers and scaling choices require inspection before coupling to another network model. Only metadata and the file list were checked; CSV rows were not downloaded.
